mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate trend indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% and is rising, it signals monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 650,000 units, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 650.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 600,000 units and industrial production falls below 100, it signals demand-supply mismatch where strong consumer demand outpaces supply, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising and unemployment exceeds 9.5%, it signals monetary tightening coinciding with labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment to cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDP growth > 3% and CPI < 3%), rising retail sales (RSAFS) signals sustained consumer spending that drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods within late-cycle expansion when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime (INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 9.0%), a rebound in industrial production signals improving supply chain conditions and manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods within post-shock recovery when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
